components.text: Independent connector for Codeberg. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Codeberg.
Sign in to the Codeberg account you want to connect. This guide binds the exact https://codeberg.org origin; other Forgejo instances require a separately reviewed host policy.

Open Codeberg Settings → Applications and generate an access token with read:user for the identity test and read:repository to list repositories and read files and archives. Grant other scopes only for the operations you plan to use. Copy the token into the protected field; the API sends Authorization: token.

Test makes read-only GET https://codeberg.org/api/v1/user and checks the returned user ID. A successful identity test does not prove access to every repository. Save encrypts the token. After rotating the token, replace the saved Ragentic credential on the Credentials page and test again.
